meta.name: db-mysql
meta.description: Query MySQL / MariaDB databases configured in .env (DB_MYSQL_N_*). Use when the user asks to query, explore, or audit data in a MySQL database. Picks connection by label (e.g. 'orders-dev', 'analytics-prod') or numeric index. Read-only by default — writes refused unless DB_MYSQL_N_ALLOW_WRITE=true on that block.

copy.tagline_en: Query and audit data in MySQL databases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly query or audit data in a MySQL database

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以查询你配置的 MySQL/MariaDB 数据库（只读，除非特别授权）。它能列出连接、检查连通性、运行查询、查看表结构，结果以 JSON 输出。
howto.when: 当你要求查询、探索或审计 MySQL 数据库中的数据时触发。需要先在 .env 文件中配置好数据库连接。

say.text: 查询 orders-dev 数据库里昨天创建的客户数量。
say.note: Claude 会运行查询并返回结果。

say.text: 列出 analytics-prod 数据库的所有表。
测试 orders-dev 数据库连接是否正常。
say.note: Claude 会执行健康检查并报告状态。

howto.what_en: Claude can query your configured MySQL/MariaDB databases (read-only by default). It lists connections, checks health, runs queries, and explores schemas, outputting JSON results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to query, explore, or audit data in a MySQL database. Requires database connections configured in .env.

say_en.text: Count customers created in the last 7 days in orders-dev.
say_en.note: Claude runs the query and returns the count.
